prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select the path that matches how you want to interact with your desktop pet daily."]
1: ["Upload Pet Photos", "Upload clear photos from multiple angles for optimal 3D pet generation.", "Upload Front & Side Photos", "Live Angle Preview"]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Select your starter companion to personalize its visual traits and behavior.", "Select Companion"]
3: []
4: ["Your Pet is Arriving Soon", "We are assembling your pet's desktop environment and rendering animations.", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
5: ["Feel free to minimize this window. You will get a notification as soon as your pet launches on your desktop."]
6: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Forever", "Your account keeps your adopted pet, customization, and desktop progress safely backed up to the cloud."]
7: ["Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on the desktop to access settings, hide, or interact!", "Right-click pet on desktop to open quick menu controls."]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet!", "Your companion is now active on your desktop screen.", "Get Started"]
9: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Click below to complete setup and start interacting with your pet on your desktop screen."]
